data.name: Estefana
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'esther' meaning 'my hidden one' and the Greek word 'stephanos' meaning 'crown'. In the Bible, Esther is a queen who saves her people from destruction. Thus, Estefana can be interpreted as a 'Crown of God' or 'Hidden One of God'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine protection and hidden blessings.

in_hebrew.name: אסטפנה
in_hebrew.meaning: עטרת או כתר של אלוהים נועדה להיות שמו של אדם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אסטפנה מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו עטרת או כתר של אלוהים. הוא נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'סטפאנוס' שפירושה כתר. השם אסטפנה הוא גרסה נשית של השם סטפנוס, ששימש ככינוי לנוצרים הראשונים. השם מופיע בברית החדשה, בספר מעשי השליחים, כשהוא מתייחס לאחד מהחסידים הראשונים של ישו, סטפנוס הקדוש.

in_greek.name: Στεφανή
in_greek.meaning: στεφανή του Θεού, κορόνη του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Στεφανή προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'στέφανος', που σημαίνει κορόνη ή στεφάνι. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Στεφανός ήταν ένας από τους πρώτους χριστιανούς και μαθητές του Ιησού. Η ονομασία Στεφανή είναι η θηλυκή μορφή του ονόματος Στεφανός και συμβολίζει την κορόνη της δόξας και της τιμής που δίνεται από τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Estefana
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Estefana originem trahit ex Graeco 'στέφανος', quod significat coronam. In Ecclesia primitiva, Stephanus fuit unus ex primis fidelibus Iesu Christi. Nomen Estefana est forma feminina nominis Stephanus et significat coronam gloriae et honoris, quae a Deo conceditur.

in_english.name: Estefana
in_english.meaning: Crown of God, divine crown, wreath of honor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Estefana originates from the Greek word 'στέφανος' (stephanos), meaning crown or wreath. It is the feminine form of Stephen, a name borne by one of the first deacons of the Christian Church, Saint Stephen. The name symbolizes the crown of glory and honor bestowed by God. Historically, the name Estefana has been used in various Christian cultures, signifying spiritual achievement and divine favor. The personality associated with this name is often considered to be strong-willed, ambitious, and charismatic.

biblical_reference.note: The name Stephanus (Stephen) appears in the New Testament, specifically in the Acts of the Apostles, referring to one of the first Christians and a martyr.

saint_reference.note: Saint Stephen was a saint and martyr, one of the first deacons of the Christian Church, mentioned in the New Testament.

data.cultural_impact: The name Estefana has been used among various Christian communities, particularly in Hispanic and Portuguese cultures. In these communities, it evokes the rich history of the Esther tale in the Bible and its significance as a symbol of courage, strength, and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: Estefana is a name deeply rooted in faith and theology, drawing inspiration from the biblical character Esther. It is a reminder of the hidden ways that God works in our lives, providing protection, guidance, and redemption even when we may not be aware of it. The name Estefana symbolizes the concept of 'God's Hidden Crown,' emphasizing that our true worth and dignity come from our relationship with God, not from worldly achievements or possessions.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Estefana is mentioned in the 13th century book 'Lapidario' by Raimundo Llull. The name Estefana carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Estefana is associated with the Christian tradition and is mentioned in a book on alchemy and mysticism.
